## Load TRACERx mutation & TCR matrix

```{r Load Tracerx mutation matrix}
# Load raw matrix
mut_raw = readRDS('../somatic_mutation/data/mut_mat.rds')

dim(mut_raw)
mut_raw[1:2,1:5]

# Merge tumors of the same patients
mut_tumors = rownames(mut_raw)
mut_tumors[grep("_", mut_tumors)]

mut_patients = sapply(strsplit(mut_tumors, '_'), head, n = 1)

length(unique(mut_patients))
uniq_patients = unique(mut_patients)

merged_mut = matrix(NA, length(uniq_patients), ncol(mut_raw), 
                    dimnames = list(uniq_patients, colnames(mut_raw)))

for (patient in uniq_patients) {
  curr_tumors = mut_tumors[mut_patients == patient]
  merged_mut[patient, ] = colSums(mut_raw[curr_tumors, , drop = F])
}

dim(merged_mut)
merged_mut[1:2,1:4]
```

## Check associations betwee mutations and TCRs

```{r fig.width = 4, fig.height = 4}
tcr2 <- drop0(tcr)
tcr2@x <- as.numeric(tcr2@x > 0)

tcr_freq = colSums(tcr2)
summary(tcr_freq)

tcr2 = tcr2[,tcr_freq > 1]
dim(tcr2)

table(rownames(tcr2) == rownames(mut))

# Vectorized (approx) two-sided Fisher via hypergeometric tails
# this is the classic “double the smaller one-sided tail” p-value. 
# For Fisher’s 2×2 test this is generally conservative,
fisher_two_sided_approx <- function(a, sx, sy, n) {
  p_hi <- phyper(a - 1, sy, n - sy, sx, lower.tail = FALSE)
  p_lo <- phyper(a,     sy, n - sy, sx, lower.tail = TRUE)
  p <- 2 * pmin(p_hi, p_lo)
  p[p > 1] <- 1
  p
}


tcr_names <- colnames(tcr2)
mut_names <- colnames(mut)

TOP_N <- NA   # change to NA to keep all (memory heavy)

res_list <- vector("list", length(mut_names))

sx <- Matrix::colSums(tcr2)  # #patients carrying each TCR
n <- nrow(tcr2)

for (j in seq_along(mut_names)) {
  y <- as.numeric(mut[, j])
  sy <- sum(y)

  # a = co-occurrence counts for all TCRs with this mutation
  a <- as.numeric(Matrix::crossprod(tcr2, y))  # length = #TCRs
  # Build 2x2 margins
  b <- sx - a
  c <- sy - a
  d <- n - a - b - c

  # Drop degenerate tables (any margin zero)
  ok <- (sx > 0 & sx < n & sy > 0 & sy < n)
  a <- a[ok]; b <- b[ok]; c <- c[ok]; d <- d[ok]
  sx_ok <- sx[ok]; tnames <- tcr_names[ok]

  if (!length(a)) { res_list[[j]] <- data.table(); next }

  # Odds ratio (Haldane–Anscombe)
  or <- ((a + 0.5) * (d + 0.5)) / ((b + 0.5) * (c + 0.5))

  # Fast two-sided p (approx)
  p_fast <- fisher_two_sided_approx(a, sx_ok, sy, n)

  dt <- data.table(
    mutation = mut_names[j],
    tcr = tnames,
    TCR_and_mut = a, TCR_only = b, mut_only = c, neither = d,
    or = or,
    p_fast = p_fast
  )
  
  # Keep top-N per mutation (by p_fast) to stay light; remove to keep all
  if (!is.na(TOP_N) && nrow(dt) > TOP_N) {
    setorder(dt, p_fast)
    dt <- dt[1:TOP_N]
  }

  # Calculate the exact Fisher for accuracy
  dt[, p_exact := NA_real_]
  
  w_indx = which(dt$p_fast < 0.05)
  for(idx in w_indx){
    m = matrix(c(dt$TCR_and_mut[idx], dt$TCR_only[idx], 
                 dt$mut_only[idx], dt$neither[idx]), 
                2, byrow = TRUE)
    dt$p_exact[idx] = fisher.test(m, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value
  }

  res_list[[j]] <- dt
}

assoc <- rbindlist(res_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
setorder(assoc, p_fast)

```

```{r}
# Format TCGA prediction results
format_TCGA_mut_id_v1 <- function(x) {
  tmp = strsplit(x, ':')
  stopifnot(all(sapply(tmp, length) == 5))
  mat <- do.call(rbind, tmp)  
  if (!is.null(names(tmp[[1]]))) colnames(mat) <- names(tmp[[1]])

  gene = mat[,1]
  chr = mat[,2]
  loc = mat[,3]
  ref = mat[,4]
  alt = mat[,5]
  id = paste0('chr', chr, ':', loc, '-', loc, ':', ref, '->', alt, ':', gene)
  return(id)
}

res_A$TCR = paste0(res_A$TCR, '_A')
res_B$TCR = paste0(res_B$TCR, '_B')

res_A$mut = format_TCGA_mut_id_v1(res_A$mut)
res_B$mut = format_TCGA_mut_id_v1(res_B$mut)

assoc[,key := paste(mutation, tcr, sep="_")]
res_A[,key := paste(mut, TCR, sep="_")]
res_B[,key := paste(mut, TCR, sep="_")]

table(assoc$key %in% res_A$key)
table(assoc$key %in% res_B$key)

table(assoc$mutation %in% res_A$mut)
```

## Load & format TCGA predictors

```{r}

# Format TCGA prediction results
format_TCGA_mut_id <- function(x) {
  tmp = strsplit(x, ':')[[1]]
  gene = tmp[1]
  chr = tmp[2]
  loc = tmp[3]
  ref = tmp[4]
  alt = tmp[5]
  id = paste0('chr', chr, ':', loc, '-', loc, ':', ref, '->', alt, ':', gene)
  return(id)
}

# Load TCGA predictors & AUC
tcga_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_results"

fnm = file.path(tcga_dir, 'TCGA_res_TCR_predictors_pval_pA_1.0e-02_pB_5.0e-02.rds')
predictors_tcga = readRDS(fnm)

auc_tcga = read.table(file.path(tcga_dir, 'TCGA_res_AUC_pA_1.0e-02_pB_5.0e-02.tsv'), 
                      sep="\t", header = TRUE)

setequal(names(predictors_tcga), auc_tcga$mut)

# Format predictor list
names(predictors_tcga) = sapply(names(predictors_tcga), format_TCGA_mut_id)

predictors_tcga = lapply(predictors_tcga, function(x) {
  new = list(alpha = paste0(x$TCRA, '_A'), beta = paste0(x$TCRB, '_B'))
  new$both = c(new$alpha, new$beta)

})
```

## Apply TCGA predictors to TRACERx data

```{r Apply TCGA predictors to TRACERx data}
calc_auc <- function(predl, mut, tcr) {
  
  .calc_auc <- function(y, tcr, ids) {
    if (length(ids) == 0) return(NA)
    x = rowSums(tcr[, ids, drop = F]) / rowSums(tcr)
    as.numeric(pROC::auc(response = y, predictor = x, quiet = T, direction = "<"))
  }
  
  muts = intersect(names(predl), colnames(mut))
  tcrs = colnames(tcr)
  auc = NULL
  for (mut_id in muts) {
    y = mut[, mut_id]
    
    tcr_ids = intersect(predl[[mut_id]]$both, tcrs)
    alpha_ids = intersect(predl[[mut_id]]$alpha, tcrs)
    beta_ids = intersect(predl[[mut_id]]$beta, tcrs)
    
    auc_both = .calc_auc(y, tcr, tcr_ids)
    auc_alpha = .calc_auc(y, tcr, alpha_ids)
    auc_beta = .calc_auc(y, tcr, beta_ids)
    
    new = tibble(mut = mut_id, n_alpha = length(alpha_ids), n_beta = length(beta_ids), 
                 auc_alpha = auc_alpha, auc_beta = auc_beta, auc_both = auc_both)
    auc = bind_rows(auc, new)
  }
  
  return(auc)
}

# Apply predictors
auc_applied = calc_auc(predictors_tcga, mut, tcr)

# Combine results
auc_tcga_vs_applied = auc_tcga %>% inner_join(auc_applied, by = 'mut', 
                                              suffix = c('_TCGA', '_applied_to_Tracerx'))
# Add the number of tumors where a mutation appears
auc_tcga_vs_applied$ntumor = colSums(mut[, auc_tcga_vs_applied$mut] > 0)
table(auc_tcga_vs_applied$ntumor)

dim(auc_tcga_vs_applied)
auc_tcga_vs_applied[1:2,]
```

## Plot AUC

```{r Plot_AUC, fig.width=5, fig.height=3.5}

df_plot <- auc_tcga_vs_applied %>% subset(ntumor > 1)

# AUC when aggregating predictors on alpha chain
cor_res <- cor.test(df_plot$auc_alpha_TCGA, 
                    df_plot$auc_alpha_applied_to_Tracerx, 
                    method = "pearson")

cor_text <- sprintf("r = %.3f, p = %.2g", cor_res$estimate, cor_res$p.value)

ggplot(
  df_plot,
  aes(auc_alpha_TCGA, auc_alpha_applied_to_Tracerx, size = ntumor)
) +
  geom_point(color = "orange", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = 'seagreen') +
  xlim(0, 1) + ylim(0, 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = 'seagreen', linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, color = 'seagreen', linetype = 2) +
  labs(
    x = 'AUC in TCGA',
    y = 'AUC when applied to Tracerx',
    title = 'alpha chain',
    subtitle = cor_text,                  # correlation info here
    size = "# of mutation carriers"        # legend title
  ) +
  scale_size(
    range = c(3, 6), 
    breaks = c(2, 4, 8)
  ) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr() + 
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# AUC when aggregating predictors on beta chain

cor_res <- cor.test(df_plot$auc_beta_TCGA, 
                    df_plot$auc_beta_applied_to_Tracerx, 
                    method = "pearson")

cor_text <- sprintf("r = %.3f, p = %.2g", cor_res$estimate, cor_res$p.value)

ggplot(
  df_plot,
  aes(auc_beta_TCGA, auc_beta_applied_to_Tracerx, size = ntumor)
) +
  geom_point(color = "orange", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = 'seagreen') +
  xlim(0, 1) + ylim(0, 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = 'seagreen', linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, color = 'seagreen', linetype = 2) +
  labs(
    x = 'AUC in TCGA',
    y = 'AUC when applied to Tracerx',
    title = 'beta chain',
    subtitle = cor_text,                  # correlation info here
    size = "# of mutation carriers"        # legend title
  ) +
  scale_size(
    range = c(3, 6), 
    breaks = c(2, 4, 8)
  ) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr() + 
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# AUC when aggregating predictors on both chain

cor_res <- cor.test(df_plot$auc_both_TCGA, 
                    df_plot$auc_both_applied_to_Tracerx, 
                    method = "pearson")

cor_text <- sprintf("r = %.3f, p = %.2g", cor_res$estimate, cor_res$p.value)

ggplot(
  df_plot,
  aes(auc_both_TCGA, auc_both_applied_to_Tracerx, size = ntumor)
) +
  geom_point(color = "orange", alpha = 0.8) +
```
